item.description:
Product Highlights
Premium Recipes with Trusted Ingredients: We use only the best, like farm-raised chicken and wild-caught tuna, in our grain-free recipes. Completely free from artificial colors, flavors, and preservatives.

Smooth Texture, Functional Benefits: Features an irresistibly smooth and creamy paste that's easy to lick and digest. We've enriched it with a functional trio: Tea Polyphenols to help reduce bad breath and stool odor, Salmon Oil for a shiny coat and healthy skin, and Cat Grass to support digestion andhelp eliminate hairballs.

Hydration Support with Balanced Nutrition: Each tube contains over 85% moisture to support urinary tract health, with only about 8 calories. It's enriched with essential Taurine to contribute to your cat's overall well-being.

Versatile for Bonding & Training: Perfect for hand-feeding to strengthen your bond, as a high-value reward during training, or as a delicious topper to enhance their regular meals. The creamy treat is also ideal for disguising medication.

Convenient & Great Value: Each package contains multiple portable and easy-to-serve tubes, ensuring freshness and perfect portion control. It's the ideal, ready-to-use lickable treat for any occasion.

==

Breed Recommendation‎: suitable for all sizes of cats
Pet Life Stage‎: All Life Stages
